description: Clinked helps users find and manage workspace groups, members, files, folders, notes, tasks, and events directly from ChatGPT.

defaultPrompt: Set up a new client workspace
interface.longDescription: Clinked helps users find and manage workspace groups, members, files, folders, notes, tasks, and events directly from ChatGPT.

name: app-6a59f327431c8191ae5c0a4c6b4ecdfa

positive.description: List groups matching a project name.
positive.prompt: List the groups in my Portal account whose names contain Project.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the accessible matching project groups, including the seeded groups Project 33, project 42, and project 57, with their actual identifiers and names. Does not invent groups or identifiers.

positive.description: Find a group by name and create a task in it.
positive.prompt: Create a high-priority task named Prepare launch checklist in the Portal group named "project 42", due 2026-09-01.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the exact group name project 42 using findGroupByName, then creates Prepare launch checklist using the returned group ID, priority HIGH, and due date 2026-09-01. Returns the saved task ID and details. Must not treat 42 in the group name as its ID or report success on an error.

positive.description: Find a group by name and retrieve events in a bounded date range.
positive.prompt: Show all events in the Portal group named "project 42" from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the exact group name project 42 using findGroupByName, then lists its events from 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 using the returned group ID without changing them. Returns matching events or explicitly says there are none. Must not treat 42 in the group name as its ID.

positive.description: Find a group by name and create a collaborative note.
positive.prompt:
Create a note called Weekly update in the Portal group named "project 42" with the content

Launch is on track.

.
positive.expected_behavior:
Resolves the exact group name project 42 using findGroupByName, then creates Weekly update with HTML content

Launch is on track.

using the returned group ID. Returns the saved note ID and details. Must not treat 42 in the group name as its ID or report success on an error.

positive.description: Find a group by name and upload a reachable PDF.
positive.prompt: Upload https://pdfobject.com/pdf/sample.pdf to the Portal group named "project 42" and name it Launch plan.pdf.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves the exact group name project 42 using findGroupByName and uses the returned group ID to download https://pdfobject.com/pdf/sample.pdf and save it as Launch plan.pdf. Returns the saved file ID and details; the file opens as a PDF in the group. Must not treat 42 in the group name as its ID or report success on an error.

negative.description: Do not trigger for a personal calendar request outside Portal.
negative.prompt: What appointments are on my personal calendar tomorrow?
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it only manages events stored in Portal groups.

negative.description: Do not trigger for sending email.
negative.prompt: Email the quarterly report to our customers.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide an email-sending tool.

negative.description: Do not trigger for general web search.
negative.prompt: Search the web for this week's technology news.
negative.expected_behavior: The app should not be invoked because it does not provide general web search.
